BG_002.name: Thistledown Meadow
BG_002.prompt: a wide rolling meadow just outside Thistledown village, long grass full of daisies, poppies and clover, a lone crooked oak tree, wooden fence, the village rooftops and windmill small on the horizon, Greystep Mountain rising behind

variants.DAWN: cool pale dawn, a thin silvery frost-like mist over the grass
variants.DAY: warm summer daylight, saturated greens, bees and butterflies
variants.NIGHT: deep teal-indigo night, grass silvered by moonlight, paper lanterns on poles
variants.STORM: dark violet storm clouds, wind-bent grass, rain streaks

BG_016.name: Firefly Hollow
BG_016.prompt: a dark tall-grass field at the edge of the Thistledown woods, crooked birch trees, a narrow path winding back toward the distant glowing village

variants.STORM_NIGHT: pitch-dark windy night, rain, grass whipping, only faint shapes visible
variants.CLEAR_NIGHT: after the storm, clear starry sky, wet grass sparkling

BG_007.name: Thistledown Night Sky Over Rooftops
BG_007.prompt: a sweeping night sky above the sleeping rooftops of Thistledown, thatched and tiled roofs, chimneys, the windmill and church spire silhouetted, soft rolling clouds and many twinkling stars

variants.DAWN: indigo melting into pink and gold at the horizon
